'''Set infobox''' is the upper-right box for Decipher expansions, Original Virtual sets, Virtual Blocks, and current Virtual Sets. Empty parameters omit the row. The portrait is 260px inside <code>.expansion-infobox</code> (280px CSS). Distinct from [[Template:Set page]], which only maps expansion titles for [[Template:Card]].

Parameters: <code>name</code>, <code>image</code> (filename), <code>image_size</code> (default 260px), <code>symbol</code> (filename), <code>symbol_size</code> (default 40px), <code>code</code>, <code>publisher</code>, <code>era</code>, <code>status</code>, <code>released</code>, <code>legal</code>, <code>official_text</code>, <code>reorganized</code>, <code>cards</code>, <code>theme</code>, <code>previous</code>, <code>next</code>, <code>related</code>, <code>country</code>, <code>language</code>, <code>card_size</code>.

Proofs: [[Premiere Limited]], [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]], [[Virtual Block 1]], [[Virtual Set 1]].
</noinclude>
